goal: Select ligature in wolf build, replace the PAX image's link-only cc and lld, and self-link
prerequisites: Keep the 101 ld01 structural records explicit; no category-wide waivers
Publish or otherwise provision the exact digest-addressed musl link bundle for strict CI
Retain the copied dev kernel and all ld01 three-oracle guest transcripts as a baseline
Track pax#175: syscall 57 returns ENOSYS under both current kernel tiers and all three linkers; the cross-host row remains red until PAX serves it. pax#176 adds a commit-bearing boot banner.

items.work: Emit retained relocation records or an equally independent per-site patch witness so output targets can be differentially verified, not inferred from execution alone; refine local/debug/entry normalization with positive and negative fixtures

Measure lld-style lazy archive extraction versus index-scan ordering. Hello has the same 359 member identities and multiplicities but 349 sequence positions differ; three other cases have reordered TLS variables with equal named initializers. Preserve each finding until explicitly resolved.
Implement --linker=PATH and WOLF_LD with documented precedence, no platform default change, and process-level argv/error/exit tests. Keep CC compatibility and unsupported platform refusals explicit.

Pin and stage ligature plus its complete runtime/standard-library pair; remove lld and the link-only cc only after every native dev session passes against the same Linux binaries. Keep musl CRT/libc/libunwind inputs until muzzle replaces them.
Compile ligature objects with the pinned compiler, link them with ligature itself, then run the resulting linker over the full corpus on Linux and PAX with deterministic byte-identical relinks.
Extend section-level provenance to full disjoint byte ranges and relocation patches, then implement explain. Do not infer authentication from the digest note.

gates: All compiler and PAX corpus cases: stdout/stderr/status against both pinned oracles, own-reader verification, individual structural records
Native/release and BIOS/UEFI PAX rows where the image supports them; record exact coverage without skips hidden in logs
Relocation, archive extraction, TLS, frontend precedence and self-link corruption plants observed red
Respect the separate lld17 high-half kernel issue; the five user-program controls are unchanged under lld18.1.3
rulings: Recommend decisions with measured alternatives; never decide them in the lane
